chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Doing it for nothing: youth work without thanks
summary: Lu tells Danny he works for nothing, and Danny says he doesn't think about thanks; Milt calls him the most generous man.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, I hope you get it, and I hope you try... You should try a little bit to be a little more aggressive. Because you can get into some things like that.

Well, she's telling me, 'Danny, you're doing it for nothing.' See, and I'll be running out there, and I'm doing these things, and she's telling me to slow down. Because after you do it, you know, you don't even get a Christmas card from a lot of people you do things for -- you know, no kind of thanks.
But I don't think about it like that. I just do...
I know. You're the most generous man. You've done it all your life.
